2. Two different ways to direct attention

The real issue is not connection alone, but the incentives, ownership, and power behind it.

Social Media Model

  • centralized algorithms decide what spreads
  • viral content outcompetes meaningful content
  • shareholders capture the value

What should attention serve?

From extraction to association

Ki / Social Fabric

  • people organize around relationships and missions
  • what circulates is what people care about and need
  • value supports members and shared purposes

Ki routes people, knowledge, and opportunities into coordinated action.

People + Relationships

trust · knowledge · culture

Ki Social Fabric

connections · initiatives · activities · actions

missions · campaigns · movements

Find one another

What captivates us is not always what enriches us.

The social fabric organizes attention around what people care about, what they need, and what they are trying to accomplish.
